name: hex7_async_20deg_1550
description: hex7_async_20deg (orbits/data/acquisitions) with 1550 frames per role: with 32 bands packed every 16 detector rows (RAW_BAND_PITCH=16, 504 rows) about 1000 ground lines are seen by every band, the ground advancing about 0.98 to 0.99 rows per frame at the nominal frame period.
